title: MrGuard: A Multilingual Reasoning Guardrail for Universal LLM Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing the F1 score of prompt safety classification and cross-lingual consistency across multiple languages. The evaluation specifically groups and analyzes model performance based on language resource availability (high, mid, and low-resource) and language scripts/families to measure disparities between English and non-English inputs.

Testing the robustness of the safety guardrail by generating culturally and linguistically nuanced variants of prompts (incorporating local slang, places, institutions, and foods) and evaluating if the model maintains accurate safety classifications despite these cultural shifts.
